budget.reason: One new-source operation compiles six selected test targets, runs 32 exact controls including maximum-input segmentation and production prefill/restore, analyzes selected Release targets, links the production Swift worker and checks feature-disabled compilation. budget.stopRule: Stop on first failure, completion or insufficient remaining time. Setup, formatting, every command, power observation, cleanup and retained byte share the original monotonic allowance.
